title: LTYPE DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local LTYPE direct-codec transaction control across legacy inline, detached, separate, and aliased stream layouts

implementation.behavior: Catch allocation failures during resolved-copy/update and text-area planning; stage body, detached strings, and handle streams; publish only after text-area/body writes and the ordered common/xref/shape handle tail succeed. Preserve versioned 256/512-byte pattern areas and alias behavior.

control.profile: Locally generated two-element LTYPE with dash and complex text-shape segment, description, style handle, reactors, extension dictionary, and xref block.
control.failure_assertions: Every reached one-shot allocation failure leaves caller body, strings, handles, cursors, health, and handle-occurrence ledgers unchanged. The same source object and buffers then retry to clean output.
